name: apiguru-amazon-data
title_zh: 20 个亚马逊站点实时行情，一天白嫖三次
tagline_zh: 盯竞品、查评论、追降价，不用再切网页手动刷新。ASIN、链接、关键词都能查，一天三次免费额度。
tagline_en: Track prices, reviews, and stock across 20 Amazon sites without manual refreshes. ASIN, URL, or keyword—3 free.
desc_en: Live Amazon marketplace data from Apiguru (a paid third-party API, 3 free calls a day) - product details, prices, reviews, keyword search, best-sellers, deals, offers and stock, seller profiles, across 20 Amazon marketplaces. Use only when the user asks for Amazon data by ASIN, Amazon URL, product, seller or keyword, or for Amazon price/stock/review monitoring. Not for other stores or general shop
why_zh: 它把 Apiguru 的付费接口包成干净动作，省去你读 API 文档、写鉴权、拼参数的时间。
why_en: Wraps Apiguru's paid API into clean actions—no auth boilerplate or param guessing. Amazon-only, so schemas match real.
limit_zh: 只认亚马逊 20 个站点，其他电商一概不答。免费额度每天仅 3 次，超出需自备 Apiguru 付费 key。
limit_en: Amazon's 20 sites only—no other stores. 3 free calls/day; beyond that you need your own Apiguru key. Returns raw JSON, no summaries or trend analysis.
title_en: Live Amazon data across 20 marketplaces, 3 free calls a day
